description: Course generation modes - DERIVED FROM APML REGISTRY
note: Mode IDs (quick_test, mvp_course, full_course) MUST match registry. Dashboard fetches from /api/modes which reads this file.

quick_test.name: Quick Test
quick_test.description: Fast validation - fewer browsers, more agents per browser
quick_test.rationale: 2 browsers with 5 agents each is more robust than 5 browsers with 2 agents

mvp_course.name: MVP Course
mvp_course.description: Big 10 language pairs - 2 seeds per agent for granular tracking
mvp_course.use_case: Production courses for Big 10 language pairs
mvp_course.rationale: 13 agents per master avoids token limits. 2 seeds per agent = granular failures.

full_course.name: Full Course
full_course.description: Complete legacy-scale course - extends MVP to 668 seeds
full_course.rationale: 13 agents per master avoids token limits. Run after MVP to add remaining ~408 seeds.

resume.comment: Resume mode uses 1 seed per agent for maximum granularity
resume.rationale: 1 seed per agent = if worker fails, only 1 seed lost. 13 agents avoids token limits.

phase1_translation.comment: Phase 1 can use same patterns - translation is lightweight

phase2_conflict_resolution.comment: Phase 2 uses same patterns - LEGO extraction is medium weight

phase3_basket_generation.comment: Phase 3 is token-heavy - may need reduced seeds_per_agent

30_seed_mode.migration: Use quick_test for validation, mvp_course for production
